'''Pzandias''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] established a [[Pzandias training facility|training facility]] on the world.

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Pzandias was created by [[Sue Behrent]] and appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Dooku's Secret Army]]'' a book in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series.

==Appearances==
*''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Dooku's Secret Army]]'' {{1st}}
